content.short: Cross-chain bridge with reversible settlement: every intent either fills on proof or refunds.
content.description: t3rn lets users submit a cross-chain intent once. Independent solvers compete to fill it, and funds are released only when a proof of the fill arrives, otherwise they are refunded, with a receipt either way. t3rn runs no fills itself and holds solvers to the outcome. Its bridge settles in about three seconds at the median, and users can stake TRN, ETH, USDC or BTC, including Symbiotic restaking.
content.meta: Bridge with t3rn, where solvers compete to fill your intent and funds refund automatically if a fill fails.
